title: Local scaled logarithmic-derivative estimate
statement: Let A:ℂ→ℂ be analytic at zero with analyticOrderAt A 0≠⊤, and put m=analyticOrderNatAt A 0. There exist r,M∈ℝ with r>0 and M≥0 such that A is holomorphic on {q:‖q‖<r}, and every nonzero q with ‖q‖<r satisfies A(q)≠0 and ‖qA′(q)/A(q)−m‖≤M‖q‖, where m is cast to ℂ.
lean_statement: ∀ (A : ℂ → ℂ), AnalyticAt ℂ A 0 → analyticOrderAt A 0 ≠ ⊤ → ∃ r M : ℝ, 0 < r ∧ 0 ≤ M ∧ DifferentiableOn ℂ A (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r) ∧ ∀ q : ℂ, q ≠ 0 → ‖q‖ < r → A q ≠ 0 ∧ ‖q * deriv A q / A q - (analyticOrderNatAt A 0 : ℂ)‖ ≤ M * ‖q‖
